title: From Token Generation to Item Ranking: Direct Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
abstract: arXiv:2602.07847v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative recommendation formulates item recommendation as a token-level generation task, where Semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens. However, recommendation ultimately requires item-level rankings, whereas SID-based methods derive them by decoding token-level outputs. We term these outputs the token interface; together, the interface and decoder form a token-mediated pipeline. We establish a theoretical dichotomy: if the interface is ranking-insufficient, no decoder based solely on it can guarantee exact ranking recovery; if it is ranking-sufficient, exact decoding is output-equivalent to item-level scoring. Thus, for item ranking, token-level generation either loses essential ranking information or provides no additional ranking expressiveness beyond direct item-level scoring. translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.07847v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：生成式推荐将物品推荐表述为词元级别的生成任务，其中语义ID（SIDs）将每个物品表示为离散词元的序列。然而，推荐最终需要物品级别的排序，而基于SID的方法通过解码词元级别的输出来推导排序。我们将这些输出称为词元接口；接口和解码器共同构成一个词元中介的流水线。我们确立了一个理论上的二分法：如果接口在排序上不充分，那么仅基于它的任何解码器都无法保证精确的排序恢复；如果接口在排序上充分，那么精确解码在输出上等价于物品级别的评分。因此，对于物品排序，词元级别的生成要么丢失关键的排序信息，要么在直接物品级别评分之外不提供额外的排序表达能力。基于这一见解，我们提出了\textbf{直}接\textbf{生}成式\textbf{推}荐（\model），一个框架...
tldr: 本文通过理论分析揭示，基于语义ID的词元级生成在物品排序任务中要么信息不足要么冗余，并提出了直接生成式推荐框架，以更高效地实现精确排序。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically reveals that token-level generation with Semantic IDs is either insufficient or redundant for item ranking, and proposes a direct generative recommendation framework for more efficient exact ranking.
